view.label: File
view.help: Retrieve, Save, Abandon, Properties, Transfer, Maintenance

children.label: Retrieve
children.help: Switch to another file (old or new), saving current file [ALT-G].

children.label: Save
children.help: Save the current file to disk [ALT-W].

children.label: Abandon
children.help: Discard current changes to the file.

children.label: Properties
children.help: Set properties for the current file.

children.label: Transfer
children.help: Import, Export, Template

children.label: Import
children.help: Import a structured file into the current file.

children.label: Export
children.help: Export the current file to a structured file.

children.label: Template
children.help: Copy the current file structure.

children.label: Maintenance
children.help: MakeCopy, Erase, Compress, Reservation

children.label: MakeCopy
children.help: Make a copy of the current file with another name.

children.label: Erase
children.help: Discard an Agenda file from disk.

children.label: Compress
children.help: Remove unused space from current file.

children.label: Reservation
children.help: Get or release the reservation for the current file.

view.label: Item
view.help: Properties, MakeAssign, Discard, Undisc, BrkAssign, Reposition, Alarm

children.label: Properties
children.help: Set properties for the current item [F6].

children.label: MakeAssign
children.help: Assign the current item to a category [ALT-M].

children.label: Discard
children.help: Discard the current item from the file [ALT-F4].

children.label: Undisc
children.help: Recover item(s) from the trash [ALT-Y].

children.label: BrkAssign
children.help: Remove the assignment for the current item [DEL].

children.label: Reposition
children.help: Reposition the current item within this section.

children.label: Alarm
children.help: Set an alarm for the current item [ALT-A].

children.label: Properties
children.help: Set properties for the current category [F6].

children.label: Add
children.help: Add a new category.

children.label: Discard
children.help: Discard the current category from the file [ALT-F4].

view.label: View
view.help: Properties, Add, Browse, Discard, Column, Section

children.label: Properties
children.help: Set properties for the current view [F6].

children.label: Add
children.help: Add a new view.

children.label: Browse
children.help: Press left or right arrow key to look through other dates [ALT-B].

children.label: Discard
children.help: Discard the current view from the file.

children.label: Column
children.help: Properties, Add, Remove, Move, Width

children.label: Properties
children.help: Set properties for the current column [F6].

children.label: Add
children.help: Add a new column [ALT-R, ALT-L].

children.label: Remove
children.help: Remove the current column from the view [DEL].

children.label: Move
children.help: Reposition the current column within this section.

children.label: Width
children.help: Set the width of the current column.

children.label: Section
children.help: Properties, Add, Remove, Move

children.label: Properties
children.help: Set properties for the current section [F6].

children.label: Add
children.help: Add a new section [ALT-D, ALT-U].

children.label: Remove
children.help: Remove the current section from the view [DEL].

children.label: Move
children.help: Reposition the current section.

children.label: Final
children.help: Print all or part of your file.

children.label: Preview
children.help: Preview all or part of your file.

children.label: Layout
children.help: Set margins, attributes, spacing, paper size, and other options.

children.label: Setup
children.help: Select printers and set up global font list.

children.label: Named
children.help: Retrieve, Save, Erase, Attach, Detach

children.label: Retrieve
children.help: Retrieve print settings from Named print set file.

children.label: Save
children.help: Save current print settings to Named print set file.

children.label: Erase
children.help: Erase a Named print set file.

children.label: Attach
children.help: Attach a Named print set file to the current view.

children.label: Detach
children.help: Detach a Named print set file from the current view.

view.label: Utilities
view.help: Customize, Execute, Show, Questions, Trash, Launch

children.label: Customize
children.help: Customize your screen display and work environment.

children.label: Execute
children.help: Evaluate conditions/actions [ALT-X].

children.label: Show
children.help: Match, Prerequisites, Dependents, ItemsDone, Circular, Alarm, Schedule, Every

children.label: Match
children.help: Show all items containing a specific word or phrase.

children.label: Prereqs
children.help: Show all items on which current item depends.

children.label: Depends
children.help: Show all items that depend on the current item.

children.label: ItemsDone
children.help: Show all Done items.

children.label: Circular
children.help: Show all items caught in circular references.

children.label: Alarm
children.help: Show all items with pending and triggered alarms.

children.label: Sched
children.help: Show items for a specific date.

children.label: Every
children.help: Show every item in the file.

children.label: Questions
children.help: Confirm suggested assignments.

children.label: Trash
children.help: Clear all discarded items from the trash.

children.label: Launch
children.help: Run a program without quitting Agenda.

view.label: System
view.help: Exit to DOS.  (Type EXIT to leave DOS and return to Agenda.)

view.label: Quit
view.help: End this Agenda session [ALT-Q].  Your file is saved automatically.
